fusions.name: Steadying Shove
fusions.desc: A shove with the sole that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Guiding Aim
fusions.desc: A steady kick on a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Single File
fusions.desc: You and your allies are veiled for 7 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 17% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Grasping Reach
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you cover, a grasp snags the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 5 damage and slowing it by 30% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
